summary: Dutch company ExRobotics launched the XR-2.5, a UL-certified autonomous inspection robot for hazardous environments, in North America at the Energy Drone & Robotics Summit in Houston. The robot targets oil and gas operators dealing with aging infrastructure, labor shortages, and costly unplanned downtime, where explosion-proof autonomous inspection can reduce the need to send people into risky facilities.

title: “사람처럼 기억하는 로봇”…MIT, ‘시공간 기억’ 로봇 장기 메모리 기술 개발
summary: MIT researchers developed DAAAM, a long-term robot memory framework built around spatiotemporal memory, so a robot can remember where objects were placed across time instead of treating each interaction as a fresh scene. The system is aimed at shared human-robot workspaces such as assembly lines, where remembering yesterday’s stored part and retrieving it the next day would make robots more useful collaborators.

title: 어드밴텍, 퀄컴 드래곤윙 IQ9 기반 ‘산업용 비전 AI 솔루션’ 공개

The lineup targets industrial vision intelligence for real-time vision robotics, automation, and smart monitoring, offering up to about 100 TOPS of AI performance with expandable I/O for deployment at the edge.
